items.where: NW wing (BAG 0363100012132683) plaza face seen obliquely: sixteen yellow-framed sash windows under a deep yellow eaves fascia, a door and a narrow window, tiled hipped roof with ridge chimneys
items.how: wings(): mirror of the SE wing face on the NW pand front line; 3DBAG shell for the mass

items.where: hall NW side above and behind the wing: buttress piers every 3 m with stepped tops and tall multi-pane windows between them, a side door bay at the rear
items.how: sideWalls(): six 0.8 m piers at 14.5-29.5 m behind the front with stepped caps, twin 0.7 x 4.0 m windows per bay, a white double door with transom in the rear bay (mirrored from the SE side photo)

items.where: hall roof: four brick chimneys on the slopes and small hipped vent dormers, ventilator caps on both gable apexes
items.how: hallMass(): 4 chimneys with stone caps, 6 hipped vent dormers, apex caps and a ridge chimney near the front

walls.note: Camera 35 m away at 42 deg; the NW wing stands in front of the hall side. Hall side bays mirrored from the SE side Commons photo.

items.where: SE wing plaza face: yellow-framed sash windows in groups (4, then 12), white glazing bars, a door and a narrow window, red brick, deep yellow eaves fascia
items.how: wings(): 16 windows 0.75 x 1.55 m at sill 1.1 m on the measured stations, door at 7.15 m, narrow window at 8.8 m, ochre fascia 3.1-3.75 m

items.where: tiled hipped roof of the wing with four ridge chimneys
items.how: 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (slate) plus four brick chimneys with stone caps at 7.0/10.3/13.7/17.0 m

walls.note: Frontal, 12 m, 2 deg obliquity; trees hide two window groups, read from the 2025 alt crop.

The panorama sees neighbouring houses in front of the hall SE side; the side itself (buttress piers, tall windows, side door) is taken from the Commons photo Zijgevel Zonnehuis (Agaath, CC BY-SA 4.0) and listed under w01-308 (sideWalls() builds both sides).

items.where: rear gable: four standing figures (father, mother and two children, Willem IJzerdraat and Marinus Vreugde) on brick piers in front of the hall, against pale backing panels
items.how: rearFacade(): four brick piers with concrete plinth slabs and a pale backing panel, a simplified 1.9 m figure (legs, body, shoulders, head) on each

items.where: brick pilasters rising above the statues to the gable, recessed patterned brick panels between them
items.how: rearFacade(): pilasters 4.5-9.1 m and pink panels 3.0-7.2 m between the piers

items.where: one window pair (upper and lower) either side of the statue group
items.how: rearFacade(): two windows each side at 7.5 m from the axis

items.where: low brick planter wall in front of the statues
items.how: 1.2 m deep, 0.8 m brick wall on the axis

walls.note: 2019 panorama is dark under trees; the statues and gable are read from the Commons rear photos.
Rear (NE) face of the SE wing; the 31 m camera sees the houses of the next street in front of it. No windows modelled on that face (not visible in any photo).

items.where: SE end gable of the SE wing: five yellow-framed windows in a row, brick gable with a chimney on the apex, yellow fascia returning round the corner
items.how: wings(): five 0.62 x 1.25 m windows at 0.98 m pitch with brick between, short ochre fascia returns at the corners, apex chimney; gable from the 3DBAG shell

items.where: hall front: four brick piers with stepped caps rising to about 10.5 m, between them two rows of yellow-framed windows over patterned brick panels
items.how: frontFacade(): piers at +-1.1/+-3.25 m from the axis, windows at 5.8 and 9.0 m, pink panels

items.where: 't ZONNEHUIS in gilt capitals across the top of the centre bay, about 10.7-11.2 m
items.how: sign(): ZONNEHUIS in gold at 10.72 m, 3.6 m wide, a small T to the left

items.where: wide granite steps (seven risers) narrowing up to three double doors under a flat dark canopy
items.how: frontFacade(): seven stone steps 14.2 to 9.6 m wide, canopy 7.75 m at 4.45 m, three dark doors with glass panes

items.where: tall twin strip windows either side of the centre bay, then a large window over a ground-floor window in each side bay
items.how: frontFacade(): twin 0.45 x 4.6 m strips, 2.0 m windows at 2.45 and 5.6 m

items.where: straight triangular brick gable with stone-coped rakes and short level shoulders, a small square window under the apex
items.how: hallMass(): 0.3 m brick gable from the 8.1 m shoulders to the 14.6 m apex, stone rake coping, apex ventilator cap; frontFacade(): square window at 11.6 m

items.where: temporary fabric banners on the front (programme posters)

Rear, NW half; trees. Same statue group as w04-39 (the four figures are modelled once, across both halves).
Hall front, SE half: same items as w07-219 (frontFacade() is symmetric about the axis; the photo confirms the symmetry).
NE face at the SE wing junction; the camera sees a neighbouring house (no. 23) in front. Not visible, nothing modelled.
